newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish NTMA says 150 mln punts of 5-year bond sold.
newsitem.headline: Irish NTMA says 150 mln punts of 5-year bond sold.

text.p: Ireland's National Treasury Management Agency said on Tuesday that 150 million punts of the 6.5 percent Treasury bond due 2001 was covered 2.16 times.
The stock, which was sold in a competitive auction achieved an average price of 103.82 to give an annual yield of 5.54 percent, the NTMA said.
The highest price achieved was 103.87, to yield 5.53 percent and the lowest accepted price was 103.77 to yield 5.55 percent.
The NTMA said 30 million punts of stock was available in a non-competitive auction.
